description: Retrieves every employee the calling account owns, across all of its companies (v0.27's new hired-employee system). Confirmed live and reachable with our normal, non-premium keys — scoped to whichever account the API key itself belongs to, no parameters taken. Each employee carries its stats (base/trained/revealed), traits, potential, wage, wageExpectation, training/specialization history, happiness breakdown, production bonus breakdown, and an `estimate` of its own hourly output: `production` is raw production POINTS per hour, not money (multiply by gameStat.getPpMoneyValue to get money), and `wage` is money per hour. These sum exactly to the company-level `hourly` totals from employee.getCompanyRoster.

Retrieves a one-call summary of the calling account's entire workforce across all companies: headcount, how many are trainable today, how many managers are assigned, toolboxes found so far, and hourly totals: `production` in raw production POINTS (multiply by gameStat.getPpMoneyValue to get money), toolbox find rate, and `wageCost` and `managerCost` in money. Confirmed live and reachable with our normal, non-premium keys; no parameters taken.

Retrieves one company's employee roster — same per-employee shape as employee.getMyEmployees. Confirmed live, public and reachable with our normal, non-premium keys for ANY companyId, not just ones the calling key's account owns.

params.name: companyId
params.description: The company's ID

summary: Get a company's full employee roster + hourly totals
description: Like employee.getCompanyEmployees, but also includes an `hourly` block with the company-wide totals — confirmed these are the exact sum, across every employee, of each one's own `estimate.production`/`estimate.wage`: `{production, toolboxes, wageCost, managerCost, cap}`. `production` is raw production POINTS per hour, NOT money, while `wageCost` and `managerCost` are money per hour, so production has to be converted before subtracting. This is the single best source for a company's current real employee profit: hourly profit = hourly.production * gameStat.getPpMoneyValue - hourly.wageCost - hourly.managerCost, live right now, no lag. Confirmed live, public, reachable with our normal, non-premium keys for any companyId.

params.name: companyId
params.description: The company's ID

summary: Get a company's hourly employee production/wage estimate
description: Just the `hourly` block from employee.getCompanyRoster, without the employee list — the cheapest call for a company's current real employee profit: hourly profit = production * gameStat.getPpMoneyValue - wageCost - managerCost, in money, live right now (`production` is raw production POINTS per hour, the two costs are already money; no lag, unlike work.getStatsByCompany's daily-aggregated and currently ~1-day-delayed figures). `cap` is the company's current max employee slots. Confirmed live, public, reachable with our normal, non-premium keys for any companyId.
